local function corner(inst, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 10)
	c.Parent = inst
	return c
end

local function stroke(inst, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color or Theme.Stroke
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = 0.2
	s.Parent = inst
	return s
end

local function gradient(inst, c1, c2, rotation)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2)
	g.Rotation = rotation or 90
	g.Parent = inst
	return g
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local holder = ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("NotifyHolder")
	if not holder then
		holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = "NotifyHolder"
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 40)
		holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 1, -40)
		holder.Parent = ScreenGui
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		layout.Parent = holder
	end

	local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
	toast.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel
	toast.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toast.Parent = holder
	corner(toast, 8)
	stroke(toast, Theme.Stroke)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	label.TextSize = 15
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = toast

	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()

	task.delay(duration or 1.6, function()
		if toast and toast.Parent then
			TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.wait(0.3)
			toast:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function makeCloud(x, y, scale)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90 * scale, 0, 40 * scale)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = 102
	holder.Parent = IntroFrame

	local puffData = {
		{0.0, 0.35, 0.55},
		{0.28, 0.1, 0.75},
		{0.55, 0.3, 0.6},
		{0.75, 0.4, 0.45},
	}

	for _, d in ipairs(puffData) do
		local puff = Instance.new("Frame")
		puff.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		puff.Position = UDim2.new(d[1], 0, d[2], 0)
		puff.Size = UDim2.new(d[3], 0, d[3] * 1.6, 0)
		puff.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Cloud
		puff.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		puff.ZIndex = 102
		puff.Parent = holder
		corner(puff, 100)
	end

	return holder
end

task.spawn(function()
	TweenService:Create(Sun, TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}):Play()

	for i, c in ipairs(clouds) do
		local targetX = i <= 2 and 0.15 + (i * 0.1) or 0.6 - ((i - 2) * 0.1)
		for _, puff in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
			if puff:IsA("Frame") then
				TweenService:Create(puff, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}):Play()
			end
		end
		TweenService:Create(c, TweenInfo.new(3.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Position = UDim2.new(targetX, 0, c.Position.Y.Scale, 0)}):Play()
	end

	for _, star in ipairs(stars) do
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(math.random(0, 100) / 100)
			while star.Parent do
				TweenService:Create(star, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}):Play()
				task.wait(0.6)
				TweenService:Create(star, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
				task.wait(0.6)
			end
		end)
	end

	task.wait(0.3)
	IntroTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 60)
	TweenService:Create(IntroTitle, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.wait(0.4)
	TweenService:Create(IntroSub, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {TextTransparency = 0.15}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(BarBack, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.7}):Play()

	task.wait(2)
	local fadeItems = {IntroTitle, IntroSub, BarBack, BarFill, Sun}
	for _, item in ipairs(fadeItems) do
		if item:IsA("TextLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		else
			TweenService:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do
		for _, puff in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
			if puff:IsA("Frame") then
				TweenService:Create(puff, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			end
		end
	end

	local fade = TweenService:Create(IntroFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	fade:Play()
	fade.Completed:Wait()
	IntroFrame:Destroy()
end)

local function makeDraggable(frame, dragHandle)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart, startPos

	dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	dragHandle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
end

local ActiveConnections = {}
local function setConn(key, conn)
	if ActiveConnections[key] then
		ActiveConnections[key]:Disconnect()
	end
	ActiveConnections[key] = conn
end

local Tabs = {}
local TabButtons = {}
local currentTab = nil

local function selectTab(name)
	if currentTab == name then return end
	currentTab = name
	for tabName, page in pairs(Tabs) do
		page.Visible = tabName == name
	end
	for tabName, btn in pairs(TabButtons) do
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = tabName == name and Theme.Accent or Theme.Toggle
		btn.TextColor3 = tabName == name and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Text
	end
end

local function createTab(name)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 1, 0)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Toggle
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	btn.TextSize = 12
	btn.Text = name
	btn.Parent = TabBar
	corner(btn, 8)
	TabButtons[name] = btn

	local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	page.BorderSizePixel = 0
	page.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent
	page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	page.Visible = false
	page.Parent = Pages

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
	layout.Parent = page

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		selectTab(name)
	end)

	Tabs[name] = page
	return page
end

local function createToggle(page, text, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Toggle
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	btn.TextSize = 14
	btn.Text = text
	btn.AutoButtonColor = false
	btn.Parent = page
	corner(btn, 8)
	stroke(btn, Theme.Stroke)

	local on = false
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		on = not on
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Toggle}):Play()
		btn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Text
		callback(on)
	end)

	return btn
end

local function createButton(page, text, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Toggle
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	btn.TextSize = 14
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Parent = page
	corner(btn, 8)
	stroke(btn, Theme.Stroke)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn}):Play()
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Toggle}):Play()
		end)
		callback()
	end)

	return btn
end

local function createSlider(page, text, min, max, default, callback)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46)
	holder.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Toggle
	holder.Parent = page
	corner(holder, 8)
	stroke(holder, Theme.Stroke)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 2)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = holder

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 28)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 6)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	track.Parent = holder
	corner(track, 3)

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
	fill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
	fill.Parent = track
	corner(fill, 3)

	local dragging = false
	local function update(inputPos)
		local rel = math.clamp((inputPos.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
		local value = min + (max - min) * rel
		callback(value)
	end

	track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			update(input.Position)
		end
	end)

	track.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			update(input.Position)
		end
	end)

	return holder
end

local function getRoot()
	Character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not Character then return nil end
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	RootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return RootPart
end

	notify(on and "Infinite Jump: ON" or "Infinite Jump: OFF")

			if Character then
				for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						part.CanCollide = false
					end
				end
			end
		end))
	else
		setConn("noclip", nil)
	end
	notify(on and "Noclip: ON" or "Noclip: OFF")
end)

createToggle(MoveTab, "Fly", function(on)
	State.fly = on
	local root = getRoot()
	if on and root then
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HubFlyForce"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		bv.Parent = root
		Humanoid.PlatformStand = true

		setConn("fly", RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			local force = root:FindFirstChild("HubFlyForce")
			if not force then return end
			local moveDir = Humanoid.MoveDirection
			local camCF = Camera.CFrame
			local dir = Vector3.new()
			if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
				dir = (camCF.LookVector * moveDir:Dot(camCF.LookVector) + camCF.RightVector * moveDir:Dot(camCF.RightVector))
			end
			local vertical = 0
			if flyUp then vertical = vertical + 1 end
			if flyDown then vertical = vertical - 1 end
			local velocity = (dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * moveDir.Magnitude or Vector3.new()) * 60
			velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, vertical * 60, 0)
			force.Velocity = velocity
		end))
	else
		setConn("fly", nil)
		local root2 = getRoot()
		if root2 then
			local force = root2:FindFirstChild("HubFlyForce")
			if force then force:Destroy() end
		end
		if Humanoid then
			Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end
	notify(on and "Fly: ON" or "Fly: OFF")
end)

-- ========== FUNÇÃO: BOMBA ==========
function TemBomba(jogador)
    local c = jogador.Character

    for _, child in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "Bomber" or child.Name == "Bomb Box" then
            return true
        end
        local nome = string.lower(child.Name or "")
        if string.find(nome, "bomb") or string.find(nome, "explos") then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    for _, desc in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc.Name == "Bomber" or desc.Name == "Bomb Box" then
            return true
        end
        local nome = string.lower(desc.Name or "")
        if string.find(nome, "bomb") or string.find(nome, "explos") then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    for _, item in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Tool") then
            local nome = string.lower(item.Name)
            if string.find(nome, "bomb") or string.find(nome, "explos") then

        end
    end

-- ========== FUNÇÃO: VIVO ==========
function Vivo(jogador)
    local c = jogador.Character
    if not c then return false end
    local hum = c:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end
    return hum.Health > 0
end

function NaPartida()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp then
            local c = plr.Character
            if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and Vivo(plr) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- ========== INIMIGO MAIS PRÓXIMO ==========
function InimigoProximo()
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
    
    local pos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    local alvo = nil
    local distMin = 9999
    
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp and Vivo(plr) and NaPartida(plr) then
            local c = plr.Character
            if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local dist = (pos - c.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < distMin then
                    distMin = dist
                    alvo = c
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return alvo
end

-- ========== TELEPORTE ==========
function Teleportar()
    if teleportando or not config.Teleporte then return end
    
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if not TemBomba(lp) then return end
    
    local timer = PegarTimer()
    if not timer or timer >= 3 then return end
    
    local inimigo = InimigoProximo()
    if not inimigo then return end
    
    teleportando = true
    posOriginal = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(inimigo.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 2))
    
    wait(0.1)
    
    local toque = Instance.new("Part")
    toque.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    toque.CFrame = inimigo.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
    toque.Anchored = true
    toque.CanCollide = true
    toque.Transparency = 1
    toque.Parent = Workspace
    
    for _, parte in ipairs({inimigo:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), inimigo:FindFirstChild("Torso"), inimigo:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")}) do
        if parte then pcall(function() parte.Touched:Fire(toque) end) end
    end
    
    wait(0.05)
    toque:Destroy()
    
    if posOriginal then
        wait(0.1)
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(posOriginal)
        posOriginal = nil
    end
    
    teleportando = false
end
